results.title: Antwon Rose estate lawsuit against University of Pittsburgh to return to court in October
results.description: A hearing at the City-County Building in Pittsburgh on Tuesday addressed accusations of attorney conflict and motions in a lawsuit filed by the estate of Antwon Rose against the University of Pittsburgh, which alleges the university is to blame for his death.
